notes.title: Update announcement!
notes.content:
[b]Update announcement![/b]

Hello clicker mania.
We are planning to update "Magical Girl Clicker".

New fever mode.
New HENTAI animation.
New items and upgrades.
Item Level up.
All ages mode.
Steam achievements.

The update lets you click longer and more often than ever before.
You did it! Bravo!

Updates are free.
Thank you for always.

An update is currently in development.
Please wait a little longer!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41371388/7ddd48a57fa312841196995126a152e543ca1ca4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Achievement UPDATE
notes.content:
・Achievement UPDATE
You can now earn achievements in conjunction with in-game trophies.

It can be obtained when various levels reach max.
In addition, there is one secret.

・SE volume
Reduced the default volume of click a little.

【How to get achievements】
■Download the game update.
■Earned when you open information or Trophy.
* Actually, I always wanted to check it, but I stopped the judgment of each frame because a large amount of flag transmission processing occurs and the processing fails.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40894814/c6883b265c316e535540bdc47864d728d5e4ec45.jpg[/img]

There are 6 types of achievements in all.
5 types of open and 1 type of secret.

【Added support for Japanese】
Now it supports English and Japanese.

Japanese is now displayed in the in-game text, but if the Japanese font is not on your PC, it may be garbled.
The base language is English, so we recommend that you enjoy it in English.


Have a good clicker life!
